name: Lübtheen (Germany)
description: Horizontal tricolour of green, white and red, charged at the centre with the city arms of Lübtheen (crossed hammers on red and a green fir with a red eagle on white).
history: Municipal flag of Lübtheen; German municipalities use their flags alongside the arms, the hoisted form (Hissflagge) and the hanging banner (Banner) sharing the same design.

features.role: Lübtheen arms — hammers, fir and eagle
